cmsFields.title: Polars review: lazy plans and streaming limits
cmsFields.subtitle: When does a lazy query engine help, and where do memory assumptions need verification?
cmsFields.summary: Polars repository review of lazy query plans, pushdown and streaming fallbacks, with workload checks rather than unmeasured speed claims.
keyTakeaways: LazyFrame records a logical plan rather than immediately materializing each step.
Predicate and projection pushdown are documented reasons to defer execution.
Streaming is not proof that every operator stays within a fixed memory budget.
